sup.title: Inbox
sup.sub: Every customer message from every channel in one list: reply, write internal notes, take a conversation and mark it solved. Who answered is always kept.
sup.emptySub: Customers' messages arrive here once a channel is connected (WhatsApp, Messenger, the site's chat).
sup.noChannel: No channel is connected yet, so replies cannot go out: they are kept in the conversation and marked "Not sent".

th.notConnected: This channel is not connected yet: replies are kept here and marked "Not sent".

reason.CHANNEL_NOT_CONNECTED: the channel is not connected yet

compose.label: Write
compose.phNote: A note for the team: the customer never sees it…
compose.kept: Kept in the conversation; not sent: {reason}.
compose.readOnly: You can read this conversation but not reply.

log.d: Every message, reply, note, hand-over and change, with the name. Nothing here can be changed or removed.

err.STALE: Someone changed this conversation in between; it was read again.
err.EMPTY: Write something or add a file.
err.FILES_OFF: Files are switched off in Support settings.
err.TOO_MANY_FILES: Too many files for one message.
err.FILE_NOT_ALLOWED: This file cannot be added (its kind or size).
err.NOT_ASSIGNABLE: This person cannot take conversations here.
err.IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH: That press was already used; write it again.
err.FILE_PENDING: The file is still being copied; open it a little later.
err.NOT_FOUND: This conversation is not there any more.
err.INVALID_INPUT: Something in it is not right: {fields}
err.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
err.unauthorized: You have been signed out. Sign in again.
err.UNAUTHENTICATED: You have been signed out. Sign in again.

set.title: Support settings
set.sub: How the inbox works and files in a conversation.
set.readOnly: You can see these settings; changing them needs the "Change Support settings" permission.
set.pairHelp: Write it in both languages, or leave both empty.

inbox.d: How many conversations a page shows, how long a reply may be, and what a reply does.
inbox.assignOnReplyHelp: A reply to a conversation nobody has taken makes you its owner.
inbox.waitingOnReplyHelp: Your reply moves the conversation to "Waiting for customer" until the customer writes again.

set.phones: Customer numbers show masked here as everywhere in the admin (Customers settings); only people allowed a customer's full phone number see them whole.

attachments.d: Files the team may add to a reply or a note. Files a customer sends are always kept.

err.STALE: Someone changed this card in between; it was read again.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
err.unauthorized: You have been signed out. Sign in again.
